map.如何使用疲劳恢复趋势？: How do I use Fatigue Recovery Trend?
map.疲劳恢复趋势适合哪些场景？: What scenarios is Fatigue Recovery Trend best for?
map.输入肌酸激酶(CK)与血尿素氮(BUN)，结合性别评估肌肉损伤与代谢疲劳程度，计: Enter creatine kinase (CK) and blood urea nitrogen (BUN), and use sex to assess muscle damage and metabolic fatigue, compute an overall fatigue index, and give recovery-time advice.
map.疲劳指数 FI = 0.6×CK 评分 + 0.4×BUN 评分；CK 评分 =: Fatigue index FI = 0.6 × CK score + 0.4 × BUN score, where CK score = min(CK ÷ 1000 × 100, 100) and BUN score = clamp((BUN − 5) ÷ 8 × 100, 0, 100)
map.肌酸激酶(CK)反映肌肉损伤、血尿素氮(BUN)反映代谢疲劳。归一化口径：CK: Creatine kinase (CK) reflects muscle damage and blood urea nitrogen (BUN) reflects metabolic fatigue. Normalisation: CK scores 100 at 1000 U/L; BUN scores 0 at 5 mmol/L and 100 at 13 mmol/L, clamped at both ends. The CK ceiling for "back to normal" is graded by sex (200 U/L for men, 160 U/L for women), and recovery time follows the CK grade (0-12h / 12-24h / 24-48h / 48-72h / seek medical care). The higher FI, the heavier the fatigue; light active recovery is advised.
map.💡 CK 反映肌肉损伤程度，BUN 反映蛋白质代谢与恢复状态；综合疲劳指数 =: 💡 CK reflects muscle damage and BUN reflects protein metabolism and recovery status; overall fatigue index = 0.6×normalized CK + 0.4×normalized BUN. CK peaks 24-48 h after exercise; persistently high BUN indicates insufficient recovery.
map.CK 正常参考：男 39~308 U/L，女 26~192 U/L；运动后可升高: Normal CK reference: men 39-308 U/L, women 26-192 U/L; it can rise several-fold after exercise
map.BUN 正常参考：2.9~7.5 mmol/L；高于 8 提示代谢疲劳: Normal BUN reference: 2.9-7.5 mmol/L; above 8 indicates metabolic fatigue
map.CK＞5000 U/L 或伴肌红蛋白尿需就医排查横纹肌溶解: CK > 5000 U/L or myoglobinuria requires medical evaluation for rhabdomyolysis
map.本工具为训练监控参考，不替代医学诊断: This tool is for training-monitoring reference and does not replace medical diagnosis
map.建议结合主观疲劳感(RPE)与睡眠质量综合判断: Judge in combination with perceived exertion (RPE) and sleep quality
map.按静息心率/睡眠质量/主观疲劳跟踪恢复。: Track recovery via resting heart rate / sleep quality / perceived fatigue.
map.大强度周后测 CK 与 BUN 趋势，指标回落慢提示恢复不足需延长减量。: Measure CK and BUN trends after a high-intensity week; slow decline indicates insufficient recovery and a need to extend the deload.
map.连续 3 天静息心率升 5 bpm + 睡眠降 → 疲劳累积，宜减载；回落至基线: Resting heart rate up 5 bpm for 3 consecutive days + poorer sleep -> accumulating fatigue, so reduce load; a return to baseline means recovery.
map.不够，宜多指标综合判断避免过度训练。: No; use multiple metrics together to avoid overtraining.
map.离心训练后 CK 本就升高，需看趋势与主观疲劳，单点数值难下结论。: CK naturally rises after eccentric training; look at the trend and perceived fatigue — a single value is hard to interpret.
map.疲劳恢复趋势评估工具，输入肌酸激酶(CK)与血尿素氮(BUN)及运动后时长，结合: The Fatigue Recovery Trend tool takes creatine kinase (CK), blood urea nitrogen (BUN), and time since exercise, and with sex assesses muscle damage and metabolic fatigue, computes an overall fatigue index, determines whether CK is rising or falling, and gives recovery-time advice.
map.CK、BUN 双指标分级评估: Tiered assessment of both CK and BUN
map.根据运动后时长判断恢复阶段: Recovery phase judged from time since exercise
